mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not lead to a significant negative shift in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months do not lead to a significant negative shift in 60-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month do not lead to a significant negative shift in 5-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% over 3 months do not lead to a significant positive shift in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to a significant positive shift in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 5% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 5% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.3%
failure_condition: If the joint condition (HOUST declines > 5% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.3%) does not lead to a significant negative shift in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%) does not lead to a significant positive shift in 5-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals robust supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 2% YoY during a late-cycle expansion does not lead to a significant positive shift in 60-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
